movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Double hand hold at waist or shoulder level; shadow position.
movement_profile.footwork: Steps are often mirrored; includes taps, triple steps, and skips.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Progressive along the line of dance or stationary.
movement_profile.partnering: Open or loose hold without body contact.

signature_moves.description: Step-step-step-hold, performed forward, backward, or with a turn.

music_profile.sound_description: Music varies from folk-based melodies to disco-influenced tracks in 2/4 or 4/4 time.
